key_impacts: Estimated 70,000 excess deaths in western Europe
Markedly higher death rates among the elderly
evidence_snippets: The hot summer of 2003 in Europe produced sustained record high temperatures
It has been estimated that 70,000 more deaths occurred in western Europe during that extreme summer
Higher death rates were particularly among the elderly
